# Dial Hanna

> AI call coverage for Hungarian small businesses. Keep your number; when you can't pick up, Hanna answers from approved knowledge, books when allowed, and hands you Intent → Outcome → Next step — not a recording.

Website: https://dialhanna.com
Contact: hello@dialhanna.com
Languages: Hungarian (primary), English
Region: Hungary (Budapest)

## Product

- Keep-your-number forwarding (busy / no-answer / unreachable)
- AI disclosure in the first sentence of every call
- Answers only from owner-approved knowledge; logs knowledge gaps instead of guessing
- Optional website import drafts FAQs; owners without a site can type Q&A by hand
- Structured call outcomes on a private dashboard
- Launch pricing (HUF): Essential 19 900 / Pro 34 900 / Business 59 900 per month
- Public signup is waitlist-only until paid plans open (7-day trial on the owner's number at launch)

## Do not crawl

Private product UI (`/dashboard`, `/onboarding`, `/sign-in`) and `/api/*` are not for indexing.

## Built with

Meta Model API (Muse Spark, Muse Wonder, Muse Voice Transcribe) for the hackathon build; third-party TTS for speech. Not an AI receptionist replacement claim — call coverage when the owner is busy.
